definitions.explanation: The process of a seed beginning to grow and put out shoots. Used in biology, gardening, and agriculture.

examples.japanese: {発芽|はつが}するまで{毎日|まいにち}{水|みず}をやった。
examples.english: I watered them every day until they sprouted.

examples.japanese: この{植物|しょくぶつ}は{発芽|はつが}に{適|てき}した{温度|おんど}が{二十度|にじゅうど}{前後|ぜんご}だ。
examples.english: The ideal temperature for this plant's germination is around 20 degrees.

notes: Composed of {発|はつ} (emit, produce) + {芽|が} (bud, sprout). Common collocations: {発芽|はつが}{率|りつ} (germination rate), {発芽|はつが}{玄米|げんまい} (germinated brown rice, a health food), {発芽|はつが}{条件|じょうけん} (germination conditions). Related: {芽|め}が{出|で}る (to sprout) is more colloquial and also used figuratively for 'showing promise.'
